title: 24.8 A 12GS/s 9b 16× Time-Interleaved SAR ADC in 16nm FinFET
problem: RF direct sampling and phased-array applications require high-speed ADCs (>GS/s) with both high sample rate and high SNDR (>45dB), but existing designs often require multiple supply domains or complex integration schemes.
motivation: Emerging RF direct sampling and digital phased-array beamforming require medium-resolution high-speed ADCs to simultaneously achieve throughput and RF performance without complicating system integration.
method: 16-channel time-interleaved SAR ADC architecture operating at 12GS/s with 16nm FinFET technology, using integration-friendly single 1.8V and 0.8V supply domains optimized for area and power efficiency.
key_novelty: System-level integration using standard process supplies instead of multiple tailored domains, simplifying larger transceiver system integration while maintaining 48.1dB SNDR.
contributions: Integration-friendly with standard 1.8V/0.8V supplies avoiding complex multi-domain design
baselines: high-SNDR SAR ADCs with 3+ supply domains
primary_theme: integration-friendly high-speed SAR ADC for RF direct sampling
